{"id":1509399309,"question_id":6,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1736948106,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1509399309/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Zigzag Conversion","memory":"14.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string convert(string s, int numRows) {\n        \n        if(numRows ==1)\n        {\n            return s;\n        }\n\n        vector<string> zigzag(numRows);\n\n        int row =0;\n        int i =0;\n        bool direction = 1;\n        while(i < s.size())\n        {\n            if(direction > 0)\n            {\n                while(row < numRows && i<s.size())\n                {\n                    zigzag[row++].push_back(s[i++]);\n                }\n            row = numRows -2;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                while(row >=0 && i<s.size())\n                {\n                    zigzag[row--].push_back(s[i++]);\n                }\n            row = 1;\n            }\n           \n            direction = !direction;\n        }   \n\n        string ans =\"\";\n        for(auto it : zigzag)\n        {\n            ans += it;\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"zigzag-conversion","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":169}
